findings.title: Ledger contradicts the Phase-1 negative-stock BLOCK
findings.detail: Screen 16 shows posted ADJ-2026-00030 (Laundry Detergent, out 5, running -3) and screens 02, 17, 20 and 21 show -3 EACH on hand. A blocked operation creates no stock effect (FR-INV-012, DEC-INV-010), so a posted decrease cannot leave -3. The 'Negative (historical)' label (docs item 12) asserts an origin the frozen authority does not define; FR-INV-023 only requires negative stock to be reportable.

findings.title: Summary KPI does not reconcile with the count list
findings.detail: Screen 01 shows 'Counts In Progress 2'; screen 30 lists one In Progress count and five other open counts (Review, Recount Requested, Awaiting Approval, Ready to Post) with no definition that yields 2.

findings.title: Count variance data and references are inconsistent
findings.detail: Screen 43 posts variance movements as ADJ-2026-00050 and -00051, while the ledger (16) references a count variance as CNT-2026-00012. Posted count 46 shows variances +3 and -2 (net +1), while the list (30) shows CNT-2026-00012 as '+5 net' and the ledger shows +5 on Teh Tarik Mix dated 20 Sep 16:10, before the 18:40 posting time in 30 and 47. Screen 47 describes 'Reviewed - 2 lines varied'.

findings.title: Batch history does not reconcile to the ledger
findings.detail: Screen 12 lists B-2609-01 receipt, sale and a +3 adjustment on 21 Sep totalling 20, while the store ledger (16) shows ADJ-2026-00041 +6 on 23 Sep for the same item; the batch totals (20 + 14) equal the item's 34 without that movement.

findings.title: Cost and quantity display precision is not defined
findings.detail: WAC is shown to two decimals (RM 4.74) and quantities as whole EACH only. FR-INV-093 requires sufficient exact precision with defined rounding, and FR-INV-007 requires UoM precision; the frozen UI contract (20) gives no display scale. Fractional-UoM items and invalid-fraction errors are not shown. Not resolved here.

findings.title: Approval, cancel, opening-stock and cost-visibility flows have no frozen API operation or permission code
findings.detail: The frozen registry has 15 Inventory operations and 7 permission codes (see api.notInRegistry). Screens 22 and 41 (approve), 45 (cancel), 27-29 (opening stock) and 58 (a permission list with 11 labels including 'View WAC' and 'Approve') depict flows or permissions that are not defined. FR-INV-069 requires count approval and FR-INV-104 requires cost-access control, so the authority is incomplete, not the design. Owner decision needed; nothing was invented.

findings.title: UI-INV-006 Reorder / Low Stock is not designed
findings.detail: No dedicated screen exists; screen 03 is a filtered Inventory list. The frozen screen is decision support for Purchase and Manager roles.

findings.title: Required screen states are missing
findings.detail: LOADING, EMPTY, CONFLICT and INCOMPATIBLE_CLIENT are not shown; VALIDATION_ERROR and PERMISSION_DENIED are partial (see states).

findings.title: An all-expired item is counted as available
findings.detail: Screen 02 shows 3-in-1 White Coffee as 9 EACH available and Low Stock, while screen 14 lists the whole 9 EACH batch as Expired. Expiry behaviour is DEC-INV-005 (OPEN); not resolved here.

findings.title: Accessibility structure is absent
findings.detail: Across all 60 screens there is no input, select or textarea element (search, filters, quantity, reason and note are drawn as non-form elements), no table element, no heading, no live region for blocked or uncertain states, and no dialog or drawer semantics (10, 12). Count entry (33, 35, 50) and adjustment entry (18, 19) expose almost no keyboard stops, so keyboard-only completion of stock count posting, a critical workflow in the acceptance matrix (24), cannot be demonstrated. The earlier structure audit passed trivially because nothing was present to check.

findings.title: Tables are clipped at the supported viewports
findings.detail: Inventory list screens 02, 03, 04, 06, 07 and 49 clip or horizontally scroll the MOVING WAC and LAST MOVEMENT columns at 1280x720, 1366x768 and 1368x800; movement history 16 and count list 30 also clip, and 30 still clips at 1920x1080. The Back Office target is 1366x768 and above (frozen UI doc 11), so the clipping at 1366x768 and 1368x800 is within the supported range; screen 49 is the design's own '1280x720' reference and docs item 21 claims no clipped inputs. On 02 the 'Negative (historical)' pill overflows into the next column.

findings.title: Contrast failures
findings.detail: 13 text/background pairs fail 4.5:1 across 60 screens, including sidebar group labels (4.07), the sidebar footer note (3.15), search placeholder (2.54), muted table headings (4.41) and meta text (4.23). The primary 'New Stock Count' button renders white on light grey (1.14:1) on screens 02, 03, 04, 06 and 49 because its background expression is not applied, so it also looks disabled while enabled on screen 30.

findings.title: Grouped-page titles differ from the source registry
findings.detail: Six grouped-page titles are shortened or reworded against the source (08, 09, 11, 25, 26 and 60; for example 08 'Item Detail - Overview' vs 'Inventory Item Detail - Overview'). The screen number and the rendered content are unaffected.

findings.title: Index links to a Back Office index that is not in the package
findings.detail: The index links 'MiniMart Back Office Mockups.dc.html'. It is absent from source/; the repository copy is at ../../back-office/source/. Not changed.

findings.title: The export manifest places documentation on screen 60
findings.detail: The confirmations, changelog and open-decision text are on the Design System & Docs grouped page only; screen 60 is a component list.

findings.title: The design claims to reuse an approved Back Office shell
findings.detail: The documentation page says the package reuses the approved MiniMart Back Office shell. In the repository docs/design/back-office is review-ready, not approved-visual-reference. The shell does match the approved Accounting-Lite, Cash, Customers, Procurement and Reporting packages visually, but that is not stated authority for Back Office itself.

findings.title: No requirement identifier appears anywhere in the design
findings.detail: No FR-INV, BR-INV, UI-INV, API-INV or DEC-INV identifier appears on any screen or in any grouped page, and the export has no traceability file. The mapping in this record was built by integration from the frozen authority.
